scope: Input-only RGB features at8same source-guided queries shared A/B; supplied depth/pose/teachers only construct conditional labels and sampling metadata.

roughbox top-left and bottom-right rounded floor+.5

anchor_selection: Row-major pool of true native pixels; use anchor RNG.choice among not-yet-used anchors. If pool empty try next frozen fallback; record pool name/count. Do not inspect any model output.
jitter: After all8anchors fixed, add jitter RNG.uniform(-3,3,size=(8,2)) native pixels. Same8floatqueries forA/B. Do not recenter/clamp/repair any query; actual query labels read at floor(q+.5), preserving invalid/U. Anchor label need not survive jitter.
labels: Pure conditional paired_truth/partial_truth_grid from frozen native evidence, not sampler category. SAMteacher0 never O/E. Fullnegative/O disabled; exact/r2 UNKNOWN and compatible masks retained.
